title: Good Feeling

alt_voicings.label: Colour
alt_voicings.note: hammer the sus notes on and off inside the D and A bars; Em (vi) is the song's other chord

sections.name: Verse (as charted)
sections.note: The verse line both sources chart. The rest of the song uses the same chords; map the other sections by ear.

why: A gentle, steady strum in D that lets you practise **sus2/sus4 decorations** without losing time — a stamina warm-up in the I–V–IV numbers.
hard_change: **G → D → A** with the sus hammer-ons kept in time. Hammer Dsus4 → D on the *and* of a beat, never on the change itself.
theory: I–V–IV–I in D, with vi (Em) as colour; entirely diatonic.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: D → A → G → D, four beats each, adding one sus decoration per bar.
With the strum at 70% (about 58 bpm): D–DU–UDU, decorations on beat 3.
With the record: play the verse line and follow the other sections by ear.
caveat: Only the verse line is confirmed (two sources, neither fetched in full); work out the rest of the map by ear.
